title: Indira Puteri
text:
Hi there!
Welcome to my humble corner of the web! I’m Indira Puteri, and I’m thrilled to connect with you.


Education

MSc in Mathematics, 2012, Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB), Bandung, Indonesia
BSc in Mathematics, 2009, Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS), Surabaya Indonesia



Experience

2022 - 2023, Teaching Assistant in Basic Statistics and Advance Statistics Modules, in Mathematical Science Undergraduate program, Faculty of Science, Universiti Brunei Darussalam
2019 - present, Lecturer in Mathematics at Universitas Islam Negeri (UIN) Mataram, Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara
2012 - 2018, Lecturer in Mathematics at [Universitas Pendidikan Mandalika](https://undikma.ac.id/), Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara
2009 - 2010, Mathematics Teacher at PGRI 3 Vocational High School, Malang, East Java, Indonesia



Skills
R Programming, Python, Statistical data analysis


Interests
Spatial modelling, Bayesian statistics, Conditional Auto-regressive model, Multilevel spatial data model

title: About Me
text: I am a student at the Mathematical Sciences program, Universiti Brunei Darussalam. I reside permanently in Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, and am currently temporarily staying in Brunei. My current research project focuses on spatial modeling for Gaussian data, where I utilize Bayesian hierarchical models and conditional autoregressive (CAR) models to elucidate the spatial structure within neighborhood areas. Additionally, I am actively learning R to support and enhance my research endeavors.
